record_type_quote: We conduct a conceptual replication of a well-cited study conducted at Sony Ericsson, using Lucene for searching in the public Android defect repository.

targets.authors: Runeson, P., Alexandersson, M., and Nyholm, O.
targets.title: Detection of duplicate defect reports using natural language processing.
targets.evidence_quote: In 2007, we implemented automated duplicate detection at Sony Ericsson [7].
targets.outcome_quote: First we confirm the prior findings that weighting the title more important than the description can significantly improve duplicate defect detection. Since this confirmation comes from a different dataset and with the use of another tool, we think this result might be generalizable. Yet, future studies are needed before we can make definitive conclusions. Second, we present conflicting evidence on the benefits of filtering defect reports based on the submission date.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Title weighting agrees; submission-date filtering explicitly conflicts with the original. Summary lists findings rather than an overall replication verdict.

reasoning: Identity verified against matching title, all four authors and DOI-associated university record. A different Android dataset re-tests the 2007 Sony Ericsson study; later duplicate-detection papers supply background only.
